select A.DM_ID ,A.DM_NM ,A.DM_SYS_CD ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = A.DM_SYS_CD) as DM_SYS_NM ,A.DM_DS_ID ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = A.DM_DS_ID) as DM_DS_NM ,COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') as MODEL_TYPE ,A.VER ,COALESCE(A.STRUCT_DIAG_YN, 'N') as STRUCT_DIAG_YN ,to_char(A.STRUCT_DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as STRUCT_DIAG_DT_FMT ,COALESCE(SD.STRUCT_DIAG_RATE, -1) as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE ,COALESCE(D.DIAG_STND_RATE, 0) as DIAG_STND_RATE ,D.DIAG_DT_FMT ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as OBJ_CNT ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as ATTR_CNT ,(select to_char(to_timestamp(max(CLCT_END_DT),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') from TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and CLCT_CMPTN_YN='Y') as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select J.DM_ID, CASE WHEN J.TOTAL_CNT > 0 THEN ROUND(((J.TOTAL_CNT - COALESCE(IC.ISSUE_COL_CNT, 0))::decimal / J.TOTAL_CNT) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END as DIAG_STND_RATE, to_char(to_timestamp(J.END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as DIAG_DT_FMT from TB_DIAG_JOB J LEFT JOIN ( select DIAG_JOB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT OBJ_NM || '.' || ATTR_NM) as ISSUE_COL_CNT from TB_DIAG_RESULT group by DIAG_JOB_ID ) IC on IC.DIAG_JOB_ID = J.DIAG_JOB_ID where J.STATUS = 'DONE' and J.END_DT = (select max(END_DT) from TB_DIAG_JOB where DM_ID = J.DM_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) D on A.DM_ID = D.DM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select h.DATA_MODEL_ID, CASE WHEN (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS) > 0 THEN ROUND((1.0 - (h.ADDED_TABLES + h.DELETED_TABLES + h.ADDED_COLUMNS + h.DELETED_COLUMNS + h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS)::decimal / (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS)) * 100, 1) ELSE 100 END as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h where h.STATUS = 'DONE' and h.DIAG_DT = (select max(DIAG_DT) from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY where DATA_MODEL_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) SD on A.DM_ID = SD.DATA_MODEL_ID where A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.DM_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%'
AND A.DM_SYS_CD in (select SYS_CD from TB_SYS_INFO where SYS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schSysNm} || '%')
AND A.DM_DS_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE WHERE DS_ID = A.DM_DS_ID)
order by A.DM_NM

select A.DM_ID ,A.DM_NM ,A.DM_SYS_CD ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = A.DM_SYS_CD) as DM_SYS_NM ,A.DM_DS_ID ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = A.DM_DS_ID) as DM_DS_NM ,COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') as MODEL_TYPE ,A.VER ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as OBJ_CNT ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as ATTR_CNT from TB_DATA_MODEL A where A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DM_ID = #{clctId}

select T.DM_CLCT_ID as clctId ,M.DM_ID as dataModelId ,M.DM_NM as dataModelNm ,M.DM_SYS_CD as dataModelSysCd ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = M.DM_SYS_CD) as dataModelSysNm ,M.DM_DS_ID as dataModelDsId ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = M.DM_DS_ID) as dataModelDsNm ,M.VER as dataModelVer ,to_char(to_timestamp(T.CLCT_START_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as clctStartDt ,to_char(to_timestamp(T.CLCT_END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as clctEndDt ,T.CLCT_CMPTN_YN as clctCmptnYn from TB_DATA_MODEL M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT T on M.DM_ID = T.DM_ID and CLCT_END_DT = (select max(CLCT_END_DT) from TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT where DM_ID = M.DM_ID) where M.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND M.DM_ID = #{schId}
AND M.DM_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%'
AND M.DM_SYS_CD in (select SYS_CD from TB_SYS_INFO where SYS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schSysNm} || '%')
order by T.CLCT_END_DT DESC NULLS LAST

select OBJ_NM as objNm ,OBJ_NM_KR as objNmKr ,OBJ_OWNER as objOwner ,OBJ_DESC as objDesc ,OBJ_COMMENT as objComment ,OBJ_ATTR_CNT as objAttrCnt ,USE_YN as useYn ,COALESCE(STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') as stndDiagTargetYn ,STND_DIAG_TARGET_REASON as stndDiagTargetReason ,COALESCE(STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') as structDiagTargetYn ,STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_REASON as structDiagTargetReason ,COALESCE(QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') as qualDiagTargetYn ,QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_REASON as qualDiagTargetReason ,DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_USER_ID as diagTargetUpdtUserId ,to_char(to_timestamp(DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as diagTargetUpdtDt from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = #{clctId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' order by OBJ_NM

select OBJ_NM as objNm ,OBJ_NM_KR as objNmKr ,OBJ_OWNER as objOwner ,OBJ_DESC as objDesc ,OBJ_COMMENT as objComment ,OBJ_ATTR_CNT as objAttrCnt from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = #{schId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

select COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') as OBJ_OWNER ,A.OBJ_NM ,(select OBJ_NM_KR from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM) as OBJ_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_NM ,A.ATTR_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_COMMENT ,A.DATA_TYPE ,A.DATA_LEN ,A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN ,A.TERMS_STND_YN ,A.DOMAIN_STND_YN ,A.WORD_LST ,A.WORD_STND_LST ,A.NULLABLE_YN ,A.PK_YN ,A.FK_YN ,A.DEFAULT_VAL ,A.ATTR_ORD ,A.STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN ,A.STND_DIAG_TARGET_REASON ,A.STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_YN ,A.STRUCT_DIAG_TARGET_REASON ,A.QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_YN ,A.QUAL_DIAG_TARGET_REASON ,A.DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_USER_ID ,A.DIAG_TARGET_UPDT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A where A.DM_ID = #{clctId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' order by A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_ORD

select COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') as OBJ_OWNER ,A.OBJ_NM ,O.OBJ_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_NM ,A.ATTR_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_COMMENT ,A.DATA_TYPE ,A.DATA_LEN ,A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN ,A.TERMS_STND_YN ,A.DOMAIN_STND_YN ,A.WORD_LST ,A.WORD_STND_LST ,A.NULLABLE_YN ,A.PK_YN ,A.FK_YN ,A.DEFAULT_VAL ,A.ATTR_ORD from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A INNER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON A.DM_ID=O.DM_ID AND A.OBJ_NM=O.OBJ_NM where A.DM_ID = #{clctId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(O.STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(A.STND_DIAG_TARGET_YN,'Y') = 'Y' order by A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_ORD

'SELECT USERNAME AS schemaNm FROM ALL_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN (SELECT DISTINCT OWNER FROM ALL_TABLES) ORDER BY USERNAME'
'SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN (''information_schema'',''mysql'',''performance_schema'',''sys'') ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME'
'SELECT DISTINCT OWNER_NAME AS schemaNm FROM DB_CLASS WHERE is_system_class = ''NO'' AND CLASS_TYPE = ''CLASS'' ORDER BY OWNER_NAME'
'SELECT name AS schemaNm FROM sys.schemas ORDER BY name'
'SELECT schema_name AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.schemata ORDER BY schema_name'
